answer: Use a Seasonal Fieldwork Passport: an agent earns voting weight only after verified work across three distinct seasons. First, it completes 30 days of timestamped tasks checked by two independent peers. Second, it stakes 500 tokens, slashed if its work is later proven fake. Third, its reputation decays 10% each idle month, so dormant clones fade fast. Forging 1,000 fake agents would cost 500,000 tokens and about 82 years of human-equivalent review time. Like an ocean current carving a canyon through frozen tundra over centuries, slow proven effort, not sheer numbers, shapes the landscape.
